title: fix: a record item can name many tests
headline: A build record item can name many tests in a tests list, so a build with hundreds of new tests names each one without a changelog line per test.
alignment: v1.50.1 is a patch before build 24: one record field and the test check that reads it, each test seen failing first.

items.text: A build record item may carry a tests list of test keys; the record check refuses a list that holds anything but test keys.
items.where: A record item that names many tests
items.after: A tests list of test keys, each checked
items.test: tests/build-record.test.mjs::a record item names many tests as a list of test keys, and a tests value that is not such a list is refused

items.text: CI's test check counts every test an item names in its tests list as named, and still flags a new test no item names.
items.test: tests/test-check.test.mjs::the test check counts every test an item names in its tests list, and still flags a new test no item names

verification: tests/build-record.test.mjs and tests/test-check.test.mjs: 41 of 41 pass at 3035f7c.
Break checks: with the 1.50.0 record and test check scripts put back, the three new tests fail and the rest pass.
Pending: CI on the PR, with its test check and its fix ledger.

decisions.why: Kit tooling only; nothing a project installs behaves differently.

upgrading: Nothing to run: the change is in the kit's own record and test check scripts.
limits: The test check reads a record only when a PR moves VERSION, so a PR that leaves VERSION alone has no new test held to a record item (older than this patch; a build 25 list row).

tests.flips: declared tests at main and on this branch; the PR run gives the final count

fixes.text: A record item tests list can no longer carry a test added after the swept commit past the fix-row rule: the test check names it

fixes.reason: the swept-commit rule is new, so no existing test reaches it

fixes.text: Item test keys are read exactly: a key that is not a string, has a trailing space or holds a wildcard is refused, in test as in tests
